metadata.name: Minimal Demo
metadata.description: Minimal 5-node pedagogical example. Two disconnected sub-networks: a positive 3-cycle (Drivers -> Pressures -> Responses -> Drivers) that produces a period-3 cyclic Boolean attractor, plus a mutually-activating Activities/Ecosystem-Services pair that produces fixed points and a period-2 cycle. Sized below the 12-node Boolean attractor cap so the analyses run end-to-end.
metadata.definition_statement: A small synthetic SES used to walk first-time users through the create / visualize / analyze / report workflow.
